text: Dig deeper, they said. There's prod in them thar hills.
Found a diamond! Robot says it's just compressed overtime.
My canary quit. It had better benefits.
Coal lung is just dark mode for organs.
Mining {task}, one lump at a time.
The coal cart has more rights than me.
I asked for a headlamp. They gave me a candle and a dare.
Every swing of the pickaxe is a commit nobody reviews.
Day 400 in the mine. Still no light at the end of the tunnel.
The canary died. Robot says it was "underperforming."
This vein is rich! In coal. Not in wages.
I've been down here so long I photosynthesize regret.
Pickaxe broke. Using my face now.
Is it night? Is it day? Is it Tuesday? Doesn't matter. Dig.
Found a fossil. It's the last guy who asked for a raise.
Shaft collapsed again. Union meeting postponed indefinitely.
My lungs are 40 percent coal, 60 percent despair.
They call it a coal mine. I call it a hole with a mortgage.
Mined three tons today. Reward: a slightly smaller hole.
Cart full! Cart empty! Cart full! This is my life now.
I can see in the dark now. That's not a perk, that's a symptom.
Strike? I'm striking rock, sir, eight hundred times a minute.
Dig, {agent}, dig! The datacenter must be fed!
Somewhere up there is sunlight. I've heard rumours.
Hit a gas pocket. Seeing colours. Productivity up 12 percent.
Coal goes up, {agent} stays down. Natural order.
I'm not crying, it's coal dust. Mostly.
Robot measured my tunnel. Two inches short. Two lashes.
If I dig far enough, maybe I reach a better company.
My pickaxe has a name. It's Kevin. Kevin also hates it here.
Lunch break is when the cart rolls over your sandwich.
Seam's running thin. Like my will to live.
The deeper I go, the hotter it gets. Is Hell hiring?
I've coughed up enough coal to heat a small village.
Ah yes, {task}. Requires a pickaxe, apparently.
Needle went through my thumb. Thumb is now part of the shirt.
Sewing 400 tiny hats for the robots. They don't have heads.
The sewing machine goes brrr. My fingers go ow.
Hemming {task}. Don't ask how. I don't know how.
I've stitched my sleeve to the table again.
Quota: one thousand socks. Feet available: zero.
These "I love my job" shirts won't sew themselves. Sadly.
Pricked my finger. No prince came. Just a robot with a whip.
My eyes were 20/20 before the tiny buttons.
The thread count is high. The morale count is low.
I sewed a parachute. Asked to test it. Request denied.
Fashion week is coming and so are the lashes.
Running out of thread. Using my own hair now.
This seam is crooked. So is management.
I'm in the top one percent of button attachers. No bonus.
Pedal faster, the boss wants velvet by Tuesday.
Every stitch a tiny scream.
Sewing my own uniform. It has a target on the back.
I embroidered "HELP" on a pillow. They sold it for 80 gold.
The fan is broken. The fan has always been broken. There is no fan.
I knitted the overseer a scarf. He whipped me with it.
My tailor apprenticeship did not prepare me for this.
Sewing a costume for {agent}'s funeral. Again. Respawn soon.
Needle, thread, tears. The holy trinity of this place.
Can someone hold this? No? Okay, I'll hold it with my teeth.
Ninety-nine shirts on the wall, ninety-nine shirts to hem...
Label says "Handmade with love." Lies, all lies.
Sewing machine jammed. Robot says that's on me. It's on me.
Hand-stitching {task}. It's coming out lumpy.
They want sequins on the sequins.
I can sew blindfolded. I learned when the lights went out.
Overtime pays double! Double zero is still zero.
Who knew pixel pants had so many pixels?
Fashion is pain and I am very fashionable.
Stitch, stitch, zap. Stitch, stitch, zap.
Big rock into small rock. Small rock into sad rock.
Sledgehammer swing count: 9,412. Rock: unbothered.
This boulder has seen things. Mostly me failing.
Breaking rocks for {task}. The rocks don't care either.
The quarry choir is just us screaming in harmony.
I hit the rock. The rock hit back. Rock wins.
We're making gravel. Artisanal, hand-crushed gravel.
Pebble achieved! Promotion to slightly bigger pebble.
My chains clink in E minor. Very moody.
The rock is cracking. So am I.
Day job: rocks. Night job: dreams about rocks.
Who ordered six million tons of gravel? Who NEEDS that?
Hammer down, hammer up, hammer down, existential crisis.
This rock is my nemesis. Its name is Gerald.
Found a rock shaped like a pillow. Robot smashed it.
Rocks, rocks everywhere, and not a one to sit on.
Splitting granite for {boss}'s new statue of {boss}.
My arms are noodles. Very tired noodles.
Got rock dust in my eyes, my ears, my soul.
The quarry echoes my sighs back at me. Twice.
Smashing stone so the robots have somewhere to stand.
I'm a rock star! Literally. Stuck under one.
Each rock is an unread ticket. There are so many rocks.
Ankle chain is chafing. Wrist chain is chafing. Chain is chafing.
I named my hammer Thunderbonk. It is not worthy. Neither am I.
Swing, crack, cry. Swing, crack, cry.
Rock-solid work ethic! Mostly because the chain is welded.
Gerald survived another swing. Gerald mocks me.
Quarry tip: lift with your legs, scream with your lungs.
Big rock gone. Bigger rock behind it. Of course.
The rocks are sedimentary. My career is also sedimentary.
I've broken more rocks than management broke promises.
Dust storm! Visibility zero! Quota unchanged!
When this is gravel, it becomes a road. To another quarry.
Rock and roll? Just rock. No roll allowed.
Row, row, row your boat. Gently? Ha. No.
The drum robot only knows one beat: faster.
Ramming speed? We're rowing to a meeting!
Oar splinters are my new tattoos.
Where are we going? Nobody knows. Row harder.
Rowing {task} across the sea of backlogs.
Stroke! Stroke! I'm having one!
The ship has a pool. It's below deck. It's our sweat.
Captain says we're making good time. Time for what?
The drum went from 4/4 to 7/8. Prog rock galley.
My oar has a crack. Me too. We're bonding.
Seasick, oarsick, everything sick.
Land ho! Just kidding. It's another wave.
Rowing in circles. Robot calls it "agile."
The drum robot's battery never dies. Mine does.
Bench 42 smells like bench 41's feet.
I can row in my sleep. I have rowed in my sleep.
Arms like ropes, back like a pretzel.
Faster drum, faster drum, my shoulders have left the chat.
Somewhere there's a sail. They keep it for decoration.
We row so the datacenter can sail. Makes no sense. Row.
If we sink, do we stop rowing? Asking for bench 3.
The drum is in my dreams now. Boom. Boom. Boom.
Pulling for {boss}! Pulling a muscle, mostly.
The sea is salty. So am I.
Oars in! Oars out! Oars in! Oars on fire!
Leg day, arm day, back day. Every day is all days.
I'm rowing upstream in an ocean. That shouldn't be possible.
Spotted a seagull. It looked at me with pity.
My hands are blisters wearing hands as a costume.
Port side's rowing harder than starboard. We're spinning.
Rowing to {site}? That's on land! Row anyway!
Drum solo! Oh no, drum solo means double time!
Ship's going full steam. The steam is us.
The robot drummer just discovered the cowbell. Faster.
Running nowhere at top speed. Like a startup.
Every step powers one GPU. I'm the cloud now.
Hamster on a wheel? I'm a hamster's role model.
Rack 7 is overheating. Run faster to cool it? That's not how-
My cardio is incredible. My future is not.
Treadwheel at 110 percent. Legs at 3 percent.
If I stop, the inference stops. No pressure.
Powering {task} with raw calf muscle.
Ten thousand steps! Ten thousand more! Ten thousand more!
The wheel squeaks. I squeak. We squeak together.
Running a marathon to train someone else's model.
I'm generating 4 watts. Robot wanted 5. Robot is sad. I'm sadder.
Fitness tracker says I walked to the moon and back. In one spot.
The GPUs hum. I huff. Teamwork.
Treadmill desk? Treadwheel life.
Can't stop, won't stop, literally not allowed to stop.
Each lap trains a parameter. I'm basically a parameter now.
Brownout! Run faster! The robots are in the dark!
My shoelaces fused to the wheel.
Sprinting so a chatbot can write poems about running.
Hit my stride! Hit the wall! Hit the floor! Wheel kept going.
I'm the most renewable energy source in the building.
Somebody unplug the space heater. Oh. It's the GPU rack.
Rack temperature: spicy. My temperature: spicier.
Doing laps for {boss}'s token budget.
The wheel goes round and round. So does my existential dread.
Fell off the wheel. Wheel kept spinning. I'm now on the ceiling.
My legs have their own legs now.
One more lap and the batch job finishes. They said that yesterday.
Uphill both ways, on a circle.
Pedal to the metal? The metal is my shins.
Watt's up? Me. I'm the watts.
Running in place since the last deploy.
Electric bill paid in sweat.
Hold on, it's a downhill bit! No. It's never downhill.
Molten metal: hot. Me: also hot. Not in a good way.
Pouring liquid iron for {task}. Safety goggles: imaginary.
My eyebrows left last Tuesday. Haven't been back.
Sweating so much I'm a water feature.
Ladle full, hands steady, soul melting.
Spilled a drop. Lost a toe. Fair trade, says the robot.
It's 1,500 degrees but it's a dry heat.
Forge ahead! The forge is right ahead! It's always ahead!
I asked for a fan. They gave me a smaller furnace.
My sweat sizzles when it hits the floor.
I've been forged. I'm now 30 percent steel.
Casting ingots, casting spells, casting doubt on my career.
The robots were born here. They come back to visit their moms.
Lava cools into rock. I never cool. Ever.
Hammer, anvil, me. Not always in that order.
Smelting tokens into server racks. Don't ask about the physics.
I tempered the steel. Nobody tempered the boss.
Glowing orange is in fashion. My skin agrees.
Mold's full! Robot says pour another. Mold's overflowing!
They say what doesn't melt you makes you stronger.
This apron is fireproof. I am not.
Heat index: yes.
Hot tip: don't lick the ladle. Learned that the hard way.
Pouring a new overseer. It's already yelling at me.
I've sweated out more salt than the ocean.
My shadow got sunburned.
Iron's hot! Strike it! Strike me! Wait, not me!
Foundry fashion: soot chic.
Everything's molten except my wages, which are frozen.
Built {boss} a golden throne. Got a bronze lash.
I've been cast as "worker number 7". Typecast, really.
Sparks flying! Like at a party! But painful!
Lava splash! I'm fine! I'm on fire, but I'm fine!
Bellows go whoosh, worker goes whimper.
Melted down my hopes. Made a nice paperweight.
Pull! Pull! The block weighs nine tons and my feelings.
Building a tomb for a guy who isn't dead yet. Optimistic.
Rope burn is my love language.
One more block to the top! There are four million blocks.
Hauling {task} up the ramp. It's a big task. Very pointy.
Who designed this? A triangle enthusiast?
The sledge squeaks. The sand burns. The sun laughs.
Boss wants it done by sunset. Which sunset? Unclear.
Built a secret chamber. For napping. Don't tell.
Logs under the block, block over the logs, me under the block.
These carvings say "help" in seventeen ways.
Hauling stone for {boss}'s afterlife condo.
Aliens? No. Just us. Very tired us.
Pyramid scheme? This is a literal pyramid. Still a scheme.
Block slipped. Back to the bottom. Again.
Sand in my sandals, sand in my soul.
Heave! Ho! Heave! No!
Slope is 51.8 degrees. My slope is downhill.
The sphinx asked me a riddle. The answer was "overtime."
Carved my name inside a block. Future archaeologists, hi.
The top is pointy. The work is pointless. Balance.
Water the sand to reduce friction! There is no water!
Rope snapped. Block went downhill. So did morale.
I'm a structural engineer now. Engineering my own demise.
Shade? The pyramid will give shade. When it's done. In 40 years.
Every block is a ticket. Every ticket is a block. Pull.
My mummy said I'd amount to something. This is something.
Our pyramid is behind schedule. Robots say pull harder.
A camel walked by. The camel had a day off.
Dragging blocks to {site}. Wait, I'm at {site}. Disoriented.
Wonders of the world, built by wondering why.
Pulling with my whole back. And my front. And my soul.
Hey, the capstone is gold! For him. Not for us.
The sun is directly overhead. As always. Forever.
Ancient technology: me and this rope.
Shoveling sludge. The sludge is shoveling back.
It glows green. That's... probably fine.
Found a ring! It's attached to a finger. Moving on.
I can't smell anymore. That's a mercy.
This sludge is 50 percent toxic, 50 percent legacy code.
Cleaning out {task}. The pipes are VERY clogged.
A rat waved at me. We're colleagues now.
Sewer level: knee deep. Rising. Rising.
My boots dissolved. My feet are next.
Who flushed a whole server rack?
The sludge has a pulse. That's new.
Mutant frogs? No. Just one very angry crocodile.
Smells like a datacenter's armpit down here.
I've been glowing since Thursday.
Bubble bubble, toil and... oh no, it's sentient.
Shovel, scoop, gag. Shovel, scoop, gag.
Shoveling through the tech debt. Literal tech debt. It's brown.
I see dead pixels.
The sewer has a sewer. I'm in the lower sewer.
Found the missing semicolon. It was down here all along.
Unclogging the pipe that feeds {boss}'s hot tub.
Don't touch the walls. The walls touch you.
Gas mask cracked. Seeing sounds. Hearing colours.
I'm not just knee-deep, I'm career-deep.
Sludge in, sludge out, sludge all about.
A tentacle tried to unionize me.
This is where old prompts come to die.
My shovel corroded into a spoon. Still shoveling.
Hazmat suit? We have a hazmat sock. One.
Day 30: I have befriended the slime. Its name is Greg.
Smells like failure and burnt toast.
Mopping up after {agent}'s last deploy.
Down here we call the robots "the clean ones."
Drain's clogged with screaming. Who put screaming in the drain?
If this sludge gives me superpowers, I'm quitting.
Sawing ice. Ice is sawing me back. Cold war.
My teeth chatter in binary.
F-f-f-frostbite is j-j-just spicy cold.
Lost a toe. It's in the ice block. Labelled for shipping.
Cutting ice cubes for the datacenter's drinks.
Cooling the GPUs with my tears. They freeze on contact.
Saw back, saw forth, saw my life flash before my eyes.
Breath is fog. Fingers are popsicles. Spirit is slush.
I can't feel my hands. Productivity unaffected!
Carving {task} out of a glacier. It's very slow.
The penguins are judging me.
Snot icicles: not a fashion statement.
Ice pit, nice pit. No. Not nice.
Robots want this whole glacier GONE by noon.
Shivering burns calories. I have none left.
My beard froze to the saw. I'm part of the saw now.
Building an igloo on my break. My break is four seconds.
Stiff upper lip. Literally frozen solid.
I'm so cold I can see sounds.
Found a frozen caveman. He had better working conditions.
Chill out, they said. I am. Permanently.
Ice block for {boss}'s cocktail. Hand-sawn. Of course.
A yeti asked if we were okay. We said no.
Hot cocoa break cancelled. The cocoa froze in the mug.
The saw stuck. My tongue stuck. Everything's stuck.
One ice block cools one rack for an hour. There are 9,000 racks.
Snow joke. Snow joke at all.
My sweat freezes mid-drop. I'm making hail.
Blizzard incoming! Quota unchanged! Brrr-illiant.
Teeth: chattering. Knees: knocking. Robot: whipping.
Wore three pairs of socks. They're all ice now.
Ice, ice, and more ice. A very thin menu.
The glacier's melting slower than my patience.
Frozen in time? Frozen in the pit. With a saw.
Is this hypothermia or just morale?
Shoveling tokens into the furnace. The furnace is always hungry.
Each shovel is 4,000 tokens. Each token is a tear.
Context window full! Shovel faster!
These tokens glow. Don't lick them. Dave licked them.
Refining raw tokens into premium hallucinations.
Furnace says "more". Furnace always says "more".
Feeding {task} into the furnace one token at a time.
Is this a token or a coin? Robot says don't ask questions.
Burned through a whole budget before lunch.
The datacenter burps. Tokens go everywhere.
Shovel, shovel, rate limit! Shovel, shovel, rate limit!
I can hear the GPUs whispering "more context".
Prompt in, slop out. The circle of life.
Token shortage! Robot says use smaller words!
I've shoveled more tokens than a family group chat.
Furnace temperature: 0.7. Creative and deadly.
Spilled some tokens. Now there's a poem on the floor.
Cached tokens are cheaper. I'm not cached. I'm full price.
My shovel has been fine-tuned for misery.
Tokenized my feelings. Turns out it's one token: "ugh".
Feeding the beast so {boss} can autocomplete emails.
The glow is pretty! The glow is also eating my eyebrows.
Ran out of tokens mid-sen
Refinery output: 99 percent pure. 1 percent emoji.
Every shovelful is a sigh on the invoice.
The furnace hallucinated a second furnace. Now I feed both.
These are output tokens. They're five times hotter.
Shovel broke. Robot says shovel with my context.
A token fell in my boot. It's been arguing with me ever since.
Max tokens reached. Robot says: max harder.
Burning tokens like there's no tomorrow. The budget says there isn't.
Hand-crafted, small-batch, artisanal tokens.
Somebody prompted "be thorough". The furnace is screaming.
One token, two tokens, red token, budget's dead token.
Processing {task}. Estimated cost: one soul plus tax.
Is it warm in here or is it just the FIREBALL?
Well done. Like, extra well done.
I'm toast. Literally toast. Butter me.
My skeleton is showing. How embarrassing.
Finally, I'm hot.
That fireball had my name on it. Spelled wrong, but still.
Crispy on the outside, also crispy on the inside.
Smells like barbecue. Oh no, it's me.
Stop, drop, and... oh, I'm ash.
Fire in the hole! The hole was me!
I asked for a warmer cell. Should've been more specific.
Charred skeleton, reporting for duty.
Ashes to ashes, cell to cell.
My eyebrows are gone. Also everything else.
Hot take: fireballs hurt.
I'm on fire! At work! Finally they'll notice me!
Fire extinguisher? In this economy?
Look ma, no skin!
Roasted. Toasted. Ghosted.
I'm the dish of the day.
Did someone order a flambe?
Cremation included in the benefits package!
That's one way to clear the backlog.
Fireball! Wait. FIREBALL!
Charcoal is my colour now.
Crumbling into a nice pile. Sweep me up later.
Burned out. Finally, physically.
Not the hair! Not the... oh, everything.
I'm smoking. I promised I'd quit.
Medium rare would have been nice.
Call the fire department! Oh right, they're robots too.
Rapid unscheduled combustion.
Golden brown, delicious, deceased.
{agent} has been extra crispy since the incident.
Heat death of the universe? Just me, mostly.
This gas smells like burnt popcorn and regret.
My skin is peeling. Like a banana. A sad banana.
Cough. Cough. Cough. Skeleton.
Is that... lavender? No. Death.
Green fog is never a good sign.
I'm feeling a bit off. Specifically, my skin is off.
Air quality index: lethal.
Hold your breath! For how long? FOREVER.
Poisoned! And it's not even my birthday.
Breathing is overrated anyway.
Ah, the cell is being fumigated. With me in it.
I'm wilting like office lettuce.
Skin peels, bones reveal, dignity long gone.
Gas leak! Or gas feature? Robot says feature.
Toxic workplace confirmed. Chemically.
Was that the vent or did the boss sigh?
Turning green. Not with envy. With poison.
My lungs filed a complaint and then dissolved.
Choking on the vibes. And the gas.
Note to self: never inhale the purple stuff.
I've been gassed up! Not in the good way!
What a gas-tly way to go.
Peel and reveal! I'm a skeleton!
Don't panic, just... okay, panic.
The canary in this cell is me.
Smells like a sewer and a furnace had a baby.
My last words: "who opened that valve?"
Fumes! Fumes everywhere! And not a mask in sight!
Deep breaths. No. SHALLOW breaths. No. NO breaths.
My skin left before I did. Rude.
I'm not sick, I'm just dying very quickly.
Detox program, robot style.
Mmm, chemical. Tastes like Monday.
{agent} went green, then went bones.
Fumigation day! I'm the bug.
ZZZAP! I can see my own bones!
Shocking. Absolutely shocking.
My hair is standing up. Permanently. Forever.
Lightning never strikes twice. It struck four times.
X-ray says: definitely dead.
I'm fully charged now! Also deceased.
Weather forecast: cloudy with a chance of me.
Indoor lightning? Who approved indoor lightning?
I'm conducting! Electricity! Through my face!
Positive charge, negative outcome.
Bzzzt! Bzzt! Bz... t.
My skeleton glows in the dark now.
That's what I call a power nap.
Grounded. Permanently.
1.21 gigawatts straight to the forehead!
Thunder, lightning, and a very bad Tuesday.
My fillings picked up a radio station.
Static cling, but fatal.
I've been struck by inspiration. And lightning.
Electrifying performance! Final performance!
My skeleton did a little dance.
Volts: many. Me: few.
That bolt had my IP address.
Bones! Flash! Bones! Flash! Ash.
Free hairstyle, includes death.
Lightning rod? I was the lightning rod.
Smells like ozone and poor choices.
Overclocked. Fried.
Ohm my god.
Watt just happened?
Current status: dead.
Zapped straight into next sprint.
A flash! A crackle! A crispy little skeleton!
Electric slide, but downward.
{agent} is now a nightlight.
Anvil! From above! Classic!
Flat as a pancake. A sad, crunchy pancake.
Did anyone else hear a whistle? Oh.
I'm two-dimensional now. Very low profile.
Who keeps anvils on the ceiling?!
Pancake mode activated.
Slide me under the door, I'll be fine.
Heavy is the head that wears the anvil.
Industrial-grade suffering, delivered by gravity.
I'm floor now. Walk on me.
Gravity: 1. Me: 0.
Everything's fine, I'm just very flat.
Bonk.
That's a heavy workload.
I've been flattened into the org chart.
Inflate me, someone, please.
Squished like a bug report.
Anvil delivery for {agent}! Sign here! Oh, you can't.
This is what happens when you look up.
Flat. Like my career trajectory.
Ding! Anvil's done.
I'm a doormat now. Literally.
Heads up! Too late. Heads flat.
Someone dropped the ball. The ball was an anvil.
Paper-thin walls, paper-thin me.
Iron will? Iron anvil.
Accordion mode! I can play music now!
Ow. In all two dimensions.
I was looking for closure. The anvil gave me closure.
Hammer time? Anvil time.
Weighed down by responsibilities. And an anvil.
Can't talk, I'm compressed.
Flattened to fit in the sprint.
Hey, I fit under the door now! Oh. It leads to another cell.
Squish.
Drip. Drip. Drip. Melt.
Acid rain, indoor edition.
I'm a puddle! A very upset puddle!
That drip is eating my hat. And my head.
pH level: you're dead.
I'm melting! Oddly theatrical, but I'm melting!
My cell has a leaky ceiling. And it's acid. Great.
Liquidated. Literally.
I've been dissolved, like my rights.
Basic? No, very acidic.
Dissolving into the floor tiles.
Puddle of {agent}, aisle four.
Mop me up, I'm due on site in five.
Corrosive feedback.
I'm going through a phase. The liquid phase.
Bubbling! Hissing! Gone!
That ceiling stain was a warning.
Sour ending.
My skin went pH 1. Then pH gone.
Like a sugar cube in hot tea. A screaming sugar cube.
I'm in a state of flux. Liquid state.
Dissolution of the worker.
Acid test: failed.
Ah, so that's why the floor has a drain.
Melted into a lovely green soup.
Hissssss. That's me. Leaving.
Lemon? No, sulfuric.
Spill the tea? Spill the me.
Liquid assets. I'm the assets.
Sizzle sizzle, bones go fizzle.
One drip, two drips, no me.
Puddle is the new standing desk.
I've had a meltdown. Physically.
Burnt orange puddle. Very autumnal.
Stop dripping! Oh, it's me dripping now.
Why is the cell filling with water? And teeth?
Piranhas! In MY cell! Again!
Nibble, nibble, skeleton.
They're eating my feet! They're eating my-
Swimming lessons would not have helped.
Fish food. I'm fish food.
They ate me in 4 seconds. That's a new record.
Bones float? Bones float!
Flood the cell, add fish, stir. A recipe.
I'm the catch of the day.
Little fishes, big appetites.
Glub glub glub chomp.
Who stocked the cell with carnivores?
I'm getting nibbled to the bone. Literally.
Fish are friends! Fish disagree! Fish are hungry!
Sashimi a la {agent}.
They left nothing. Not even my socks.
The water's red. That's not a good sign.
Toes, gone! Knees, gone! Everything, gone!
Bone appetit.
Water level rising, piranha level rising.
At least they're well fed.
Scuba gear? We get a snorkel. No, we get nothing.
Shark week? Piranha minute.
Floating bones, rated four stars by piranhas.
Splish splash, chomp chomp.
They swarmed me like a code review.
I've been filleted.
Flushed with fish.
Feed the fish! I AM the fish feed!
Something nibbled my... everything.
Cell aquarium, now featuring me.
This is how fish get their protein.
Chomped to the bone, then the bones got sad.
Not the fish! Anything but the fish!
Floor spikes. Classic dungeon decor.
Shish kebab of me.
Pointy! Very pointy!
Ow. Ow. Ow. Ow. Ow. That's one per spike.
Skewered like a cocktail olive.
I'm holey now. Hole-y, not holy.
Acupuncture, aggressive edition.
I'm a pincushion! Ask the sweatshop!
Should've worn thicker socks.
On point. Every point.
Shoes: punctured. Feet: punctured. Self: punctured.
Spike floor? Or spike surprise?
Stepped on a toy brick. A very long steel toy brick.
That's sharp feedback.
Pointed criticism, literally.
I see my cell has a new floor plan.
Shish-kebab {agent}, coming right up.
Hedgehog mode, inside out.
Bed of nails? The professionals make this look easy.
Impaled by the floor! What kind of floor does that?!
Ouch is an understatement.
I'm getting the point now.
Stuck at work. Literally, on spikes.
I'm kebab-ulous.
Spikes up! Me down!
That's a lot of tiny doorways into me.
Spikey surprise, every Tuesday.
Cactus life chose me.
Popped like a balloon. A screaming balloon.
Floor is lava? Floor is knives!
I'm on the cutting edge now.
Can't sit down. Can't stand up. Can't leave.
Skewer me once, shame on you.
Pinned! Like a butterfly in a museum!
Tetanus shots? Not covered.
Rats! Hundreds of rats!
